subject: STABLE texture-opus #7: sub-range/retyped texture views (render into mip levels, sample single levels/slices) + YCbCr converted shadows as RGB10A2 (half memory)
body: render_encoder.inc a7035442: newTextureViewWithPixelFormat:textureType:levels:slices: now implements Metal's casts (2D<->2DArray, 2DArray<->Cube/CubeArray, Cube->2D/2DArray, CubeArray->Cube/2D/2DArray, 1D<->1DArray, 2DMS<->2DMSArray) and any level/slice sub-range (3D: all slices). The view shares the backing with its mip records shifted to the first level/layer, so CPU access, the v2 sidecar and render passes see an ordinary texture whose level 0 is the view's: a pass into mip level N works through a level view (status 4 on host), sampling one level/slice works (status 4). Shadows/imports: single-level only. render_encoder_host_test.inc e8e8447e: the two old refusal asserts (2D->2DArray view, level-1 view) are Metal-legal and now assert the view shape. YCbCr converted snapshots: RGB10A2 internal (11 MB for 1125x2436 instead of 22 MB), code = round(v*1023/2048) (tested for all 2049 v), sRGB twins stay RGBA16F; ycbcr_decode.h 6b0bf3a8, tests a1c3c529/5c38b7d1. Gates: ARM64 frontend objects PASS, render harness PASS, CA test PASS 41, iosurface_cpu PASS, texture_format_frontend_test PASS (VIEWS ok=1, all earlier cases), integration 1005/2 (known CA only). Snapshot gpu/build/texture-coverage-20261026/p7-views-stable. With level views in place, GPU mip generation (#15) is now a small add-on (fullscreen bilinear pass per level through level views) once an internal AIR shader is authored - still low measured gain (0.9% exec on c6l). Waiting on root's assignment for the translator-variant contract; meanwhile next: planner admission for cube/cube-array/3D/MS/1D sampling + n2t depth/stencil sampled formats.
